bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
r=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00'") || exit 70
if test "$r" -eq 0; then exit 80; fi
a=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM announcement_posts WHERE request_key LIKE 'room-announcement:%' AND updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00'") || exit 71
if test "$a" -eq 0; then exit 81; fi
l=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM room_join_links x JOIN room_posts r ON x.room_id=r.room_id WHERE r.updated_at >= '2026-11-11 14:45:00+00' AND r.updated_at < '2026-11-11 15:25:00+00'") || exit 72
if test "$l" -eq 0; then exit 82; fi
echo ROOM_TIMEWINDOW_LINKED_SOURCE_EXISTS
